answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond that is slashed if duplicate identities are proven, so creating many fake agents becomes expensive: the stake must be locked before any voyage of paid work begins, like a deposit returned only after honest completion. A shared registry links reputation across tasks, so a fresh yarrow identity with no history earns nothing, while an onyx record of verified work unlocks higher-value jobs. Attackers must therefore pay real capital per identity instead of spawning free copies.
